open_engineering: Southco publishes BOTH a 10 675 N average ultimate static load for the R4-30 AND a 222 N max DYNAMIC working load. Our computed service pull is 383 N per latch. The static margin is 27x; the dynamic figure is a door-slam rating and we read it as not governing a sustained aerodynamic/cornering pull -- but that reading is OURS, not Southco's. Confirm with Southco which rating governs a sustained static pull before fabrication release. If the 222 N figure does govern, the fix is a third latch per socket, which the flange already has room for.
The R4-30 claw throat is not dimensioned in any Southco literature. Our throat/fork geometry is a representation sized to clear the Dia 12.7 striker; pull Southco's 2D/3D CAD.
Southco does not publish the AC cable conduit OD, nor the R4-30's required release travel. The handle delivers 11.1-13.2 mm; whether that is enough is unconfirmed.
JW Winco GN 7233 is a multi-joint linkage. Every clearance and strut number here assumes a pure rotation about the design axis. Re-run against the vendor CAD coupler curve.
not_checked: FEA of the shell, the gear-tunnel cantilever, the roof hardpoints or the hatch surround
Sealing performance (water/dust ingress) -- requires a physical test
Real-truck fit: every bed-rail and cab-interface dimension is still photo/guide derived
Latch endurance, salt spray, UV -- vendor qualification data not obtained
Solid swept-volume interference of the leaf against the carbon shell (shell lives in the Blender model, not yet regenerated as CAD)
Fabrication release, tooling, prototype fit, purchases, Nate-only design approval
